capabilities: Import all posts from a Naver blog by blog ID
Import individual blog or cafe articles by URL
Download images locally and convert YouTube links to native embeds
Generate tags and excerpts via OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Ollama
extras: The manifest carries an 'unreviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; private cafe access requires manually extracting Naver session cookies from the browser, and AI features are optional.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull posts from Naver Blog or Naver Cafe into a vault as Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Auto-generate tags and excerpts using OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Ollama

requires.name: Naver login cookies (NID_AUT / NID_SES) for private cafes

summary: Imports Naver Blog and Cafe posts into the vault as Markdown, with optional AI-generated tags and excerpts.
